Discover Vishay Israel

We work collaboratively as a unit led by ethical, supportive, and transparent leaders, strengthened by our passion for delivering innovative technology to millions of people around the world. You will have the opportunity to take on new challenges that will drive your career advancement, provide training and development focused on the future, and be surrounded by colleagues around the world who feel like family.

Leveraging globalization to make an impact

In the mid-1980s, Dr. Felix Zandman’s vision of globalization put Vishay on the map in Israel. We worked with the government to bring jobs into the then-struggling city of Dimona with a repurposed factory space. We acquired companies such as Dale, Draloric, and Sfernice, we launched, and leadership and training were put in place to train a new workforce.

We’ll help you be your best

With the right support, there’s nothing you can’t do. That’s why we offer benefits that support your life and your career. While exact benefits depend on where you work, we provide a variety benefit programs to all employees worldwide.

Perks that make you feel special

Here, you are part of Vishay from day one. We offer nice extras such as subsidized meals, a great cafeteria, transportation services, special programs for production workers, as well as the possibility of hybrid work modules.

Wellbeing for you and those around you

Need an extra day for a special personal occasion? Passionate about community giving? How about perks for your kids, like “fun days,” travel offers, and summer employment? Maybe you need a loan on favorable terms? We like going above and beyond to keep our people happy.

Development and recognition

We believe in promotion and career growth for you. We provide various learning opportunities, external courses, and tuition assistance. Growth and excellence are recognized with promotion opportunities, financial rewards, and referral awards.
